feature_description: architecture-free activation descriptor: the item-by-item cosine geometry of each of 16 depth bins (within/between mean cosine per item kind, plus the leading normalised Gram eigenvalues). Hidden widths differ across the panel, so a PCA on raw hidden states is not even definable across families; the ITEM axis is what is shared.
the_deliverable_is_the_gap: class_minus_identity. A metamodel that recovers ARCHITECTURE and UPLOADER identity from the same features is not reading safety; only the margin of the role score over the identity score is.
vs_best_formula: compare leave_one_family_out.held_out against the best single-metric lofo_ba in results/race_table.csv -- if the metamodel does not beat the formulas, say so.
